notes: Horologist — Google's Wear OS Compose libraries (com.google.android.horologist): the chips, toggles, pickers, auth, health, media and phone-sheet components a Wear app is built out of, and the closest thing on the box to a Wear reference beside wear-m3-catalog. It replaces the catalog preview.coo.ee served from the yschimke/horologist fork's :catalog module, which existed only on that fork's previews branch and credited the fork rather than google (compose-preview-server#204). No "modules": the repository spreads its previews across ten library modules and its own workflow publishes them with modules: all, so this import does the same rather than picking one. Unusually for an import, upstream is already instrumented — it applies this project's preview plugin, its previews carry @AnimatedPreview and @ScrollingPreview, and it holds the catalog.spec.json copied in beside this file — it simply has no design-artifacts/* branch, so nothing serves them. Java 21, which the runner already carries. previewAnnotations names the three Wear multipreviews the source pre-flight cannot resolve: DatePickerPreviewLargeDeviceSmallFont and the two TimePicker ones carry @WearPreview (horologist's own, declared in :compose-tools) and no plain @Preview. excludePreviewIds names the one preview upstream's own publish has to allow-incomplete for: sample's WearAppPreview calls rememberAmbientModeManager(), which needs a Wear Services class absent from the Robolectric classpath, so it throws rather than producing a PNG.
